title: Random dynamics of plane polynomial automorphisms
summary: Let $μ$ be a finitely supported probability measure on the group of automorphisms of $\mathbb{A}^2_\mathbb{C}$. If the group generated by the support of $μ$ is non-elementary and contains only loxodromic elements, we show the existence of dynamical Green functions associated to random products. We derive consequences for $μ$-stationary measures: they are compactly supported, and we can apply Roda's theorem to show stiffness when the action is non-dissipative.
